summary: End-to-end ML platforms combine training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, and scalable deployment into a single managed environment, which matters when you are building or customizing models, managing many experiments, enforcing governance, and serving at scale. You need a platform (versus just calling a hosted model API) when you train/fine-tune your own models, require reproducibility and lineage, deploy custom pipelines, or must meet enterprise security and MLOps requirements; a plain model API suffices when you only consume a pre-built model for inference. The current landscape is led by the three hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), with Databricks emerging as the dominant multi-cloud unified alternative, plus specialized MLOps and AutoML tools filling targeted niches.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/instance-hours for training, inference endpoints, notebooks, plus storage; no upfront license.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams developing and deploying custom models at scale with deep AWS integration.

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/VM usage and managed endpoints; no separate platform license, billed through Azure.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance and responsible-AI tooling.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute, training hours, prediction nodes, and API calls to foundation models; no upfront license.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a highly automated, AutoML-forward platform with strong access to Google foundation models.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based pricing via DBUs (Databricks Units) layered on top of underlying cloud compute.
platforms.best_for: Collaborative data science and heavy data engineering/ETL on a unified, multi-cloud lakehouse.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; managed versions billed through Databricks or cloud providers.
platforms.best_for: Teams needing an open, framework-agnostic experiment tracking and model registry standard.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; subscription/seat-based pricing for teams and enterprise.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and visualization.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Business and analytics teams wanting automated end-to-end model building with minimal coding.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; Driverless AI and enterprise cloud via commercial subscription.
platforms.best_for: Organizations wanting powerful AutoML with open-source roots and strong explainability.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based pay-per-second for CPU/GPU compute with a free monthly credit tier.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless, code-first GPU infrastructure for training and deploying models fast.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.cloud: Multi-cloud (IBM Cloud, AWS, Azure) and on-premises
platforms.pricing: Subscription and consumption-based pricing per resource unit; enterprise contracts.
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises needing governed, hybrid-cloud foundation model development with IBM support.
